answer: Proof of Stake consensus enforces Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, turning identity creation into a costly financial investment rather than a cheap digital whisper. Under this cedar security architecture, validators earn rewards proportional to their staked onyx reserves, ensuring that an attacker must acquire a majority of the network value to subvert the system. This economic barrier makes the marginal cost of spawning fake identities exponentially higher than the expected gain from corruption.
